description: Update a task's title, assignee, due date, reminders, notes or urgency. Only the fields you send change.

assignedToMemberId.description: Member id to assign. Empty string unassigns.

dueDate.description: New due date, YYYY-MM-DD. Empty string clears it.

id.description: Task id from create_task or list_tasks.

isUrgent.description: Mark the task urgent so it is shown first and highlighted: true marks urgent, false clears it, omit to leave unchanged.

notes.description: Freeform notes. Not for assignment info.

preparationDate.description: Legacy single reminder date, YYYY-MM-DD; use reminderOffsetMinutes instead. Ignored when reminderOffsetMinutes is sent. Must be on or before dueDate. Empty string clears it; clearing dueDate clears it. On a task without reminderOffsetMinutes, changing dueDate does not move it. On a task with reminderOffsetMinutes the server keeps it in step with dueDate: a different date replaces every reminder with that one, and an empty string removes them all.

reminderOffsetMinutes.description: New reminder lead times, in minutes before the due date. Send the full list: it replaces the current one. [] clears all reminders; omit to keep them. Each value is whole hours, 60-1380 (1-23 hours), or whole days, a multiple of 1440 up to 525600 (365 days); a week is 10080. Up to 5 values. A due date counts from 00:00 on that day, so 300 (5 hours) is 19:00 the evening before. Day and week reminders arrive at 19:00 on the earlier day; hour reminders arrive that many hours before, or up to 15 minutes earlier. Reminders move with dueDate, need a due date, and are cleared when dueDate is cleared.

items.description: One lead time in minutes: whole hours 60-1380, or a multiple of 1440 for days.

name: update_task
